note: Lincoln County park on a point on the south side of Lake Shaokatan, north of Lake Benton, with a swimming beach, a shelter house, a playground, a boat launch and a fish-cleaning shed. --Claude
summary: County parks page read: 30 water/electric sites plus sites without hookups, $30 electric / $25 without, seasonal $2,000, showers, dump. Lakeview kept (the east loop looks across its own beach and day-use lawn ~40 m to the lake; the west cluster is wooded). Phone added; note cleaned. Booking method not stated by the county.
